authority: Official public listen-home source, statically inspected; no account/backend/mobile runtime acceptance

units.yearItems.playDuration: seconds, lazy11461 uses69650.r8; 2024 uses69650.Ew whose input also seconds and whose displayed hours round upward

calendar: China civil timezone; public startOf(week) begins Sunday; historical response must match selected actual interval
annualBoundary: The official annual lazy chunk renders yearItems as yearly aggregates and report links; no monthly series is supplied. UI displays actual returned years and does not fabricate monthly values.
todayBoundary: Today-list endpoint has no historical date argument. The UI labels it today separately from any historical chart; prior-day cached rows retain their own visible date.
